children: The top AI hyperscalers and neoclouds are expected to post much wider free cash losses next year, StoneX analysts project in a note, raising questions about capital availability to bridge the deficit. Looking at six top hyperscalers, plus neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius, analysts estimate free cash losses across the group are expected to be more than $309 billion in 2027, compared with a loss of more than $112 billion this year. "The inability to fund this free cash flow deficit over the next few years represents the single greatest concern on Wall Street at the moment, and until investors feel more confident about funding the deficit (or willingness to fund it), chip companies with heavy exposure to the data center market may struggle to re-rate higher," the analysts say. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
